headlines.title: Questions grow about Gaza’s future after Trump announces deal to disarm Hamas
headlines.description: There are growing questions about Gaza’s future after President Trump announced a potential breakthrough deal that would require Hamas to disarm, in exchange for Israel pulling back troops from the enclave. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on what life has been like for people living there.

headlines.title: State Department urges Americans to consider leaving Middle East as regional conflict escalates
headlines.description: The State Department on Saturday urged Americans across the Middle East to consider leaving the region or be prepared to depart on short notice, warning of flight disruptions and security risks as the conflict with Iran escalates.

headlines.title: 3 dead, 2 injured in shooting incident in Twin Falls, Idaho
headlines.description: Three people were killed in what police described as an “active shooter incident” around an In-N-Out Burger and other businesses in Twin Falls, Idaho, on Saturday, a city spokesperson said. NBC News’ Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Vincent Pastore, mob enforcer on ‘The Sopranos,’ dies at 80
headlines.description: Vincent Pastore, who played Tony Soprano’s best friend turned informant on HBO’s mob drama “The Sopranos,” has died, a representative confirmed Saturday.

headlines.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro on decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: Spain ramps up security amid migrant crisis
headlines.description: Officials in Spain were ramping up security on Saturday after tens of thousands of migrants crossed into an enclave on the border with Morocco. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
